channel.title: Official EVO Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Official EVO Magazine (evo.co.uk)

item.title: Italdesign's Honda NSX coach build is a tribute to the original Japanese supercar
item.description: With Honda's blessing Italdesign is creating an ultra-limited tribute to the original NSX based on the bygone hybrid supercar

item.title: The Volkswagen Golf GTI Edition 50 is finally here, and it costs close to £50k
item.description: Volkswagen is finally letting the Mk8 Golf GTI off its leash with a hardcore, track-honed version called the Edition 50. Now we know how much it will cost

item.title: Your old Ford may last longer thanks to cut-price OEM parts
item.description: Ford has reduced parts prices by up to 25 per cent for its older models, potentially extending their life, improving residuals and reducing insurance costs

item.title: Caterham Project V is delayed, but a running prototype is finally here
item.description: Caterham’s new age electric coupe is now officially behind schedule, but the first running prototype has now been unveiled at the Tokyo Auto Salon

item.title: Ford Bronco RTR is a budget-conscious Defender V8
item.description: Drift star Vaughn Gittin Jr’s RTR is now a factory-ratified Ford performance brand in the US. It always did Mustangs, now it’s doing a Bronco

item.title: Jensen is making a comeback with an all-new V8 grand tourer
item.description: Jensen International Automotive is launching an all-new luxury grand tourer later this year, inspired by the Interceptor and powered by a V8

item.title: The BMW M3 is going electric next year: here's what we know
item.description: The electric version of the next-generation BMW M3 is now officially coming in 2027, leading the way for a new era of M cars

item.title: Ford Mustang Dark Horse SC is Detroit's answer to the Porsche 911 GT3
item.description: A supercharged heart transplant and numerous choice upgrades should make for the most thrilling Mustang under the £315,000 GTD

item.title: The Chevrolet Corvette ZR1X is quicker than a Bugatti Tourbillon – with one caveat
item.description: The 1250bhp Corvette ZR1X has already shown its worth at the Nürburgring, and now it’s posted a hypercar-matching quarter-mile time

item.title: Ford’s Hypercar will use a roaring V8 to take on Ferrari once again
item.description: A 5.4-litre V8 derived from the heart of the Mustang will power Ford’s hopes of taking to the top step
